_meta.purpose: Every transport item this site states, with the source it came from. Base for this trip is AX Odycy, Qawra - NOT Sliema.
_meta.key_finding: Route 186 is the single most important fact on this site for this trip: it runs Bugibba Bay 6 -> Qawra seafront -> Mosta -> Ta' Qali Stadium -> Ta' Qali Villagg -> Rabat, every 30 minutes, with no change of bus. Qawra and the tournament venue are therefore on one direct bus line.

routes.name: Route 186 — Bugibba ↔ Rabat via Qawra and Ta' Qali
routes.area: Qawra / Bugibba ↔ Mosta ↔ Ta' Qali ↔ Rabat
routes.address: Outbound stops relevant to this trip: Bugibba Bay 6 (3531) → Ben (949) → Arznell (950) → Luzzu (951) → Qawra (952) → Boxxla (953) → … → Rotunda 4 (2565, Mosta) → Bezzina (1102) → Gholja 1 (1100) → Gholja 2 (1101) → Mithna (1099) → Trincetta (6428) → Waqqafa (2186) → Ta' Qali. Return direction runs via St Paul's Bay (Mwiezeb 956, Imhasel 958, Toni 6013, Gillieru 6014) and the Bugibba seafront (Moll 6193, Rizzi 946, Sajf 947, Gzejjer 948) to Bugibba Bay 1 (2527).
routes.hours: Outbound from Bugibba Bay 6: 06:05 every 30 min to 21:35 (32 departures published). Qawra stops Arznell 06:08–21:37, Luzzu 06:09–21:38, Qawra 06:10–21:38, Boxxla 06:11–21:39. Return direction last published passing time at Bugibba Bay 1 is 21:26.
routes.price_range: Day Route fare: €2.00 winter / €2.50 summer (2-hour validity, free transfers inside 2 h); included in the €25 Explore Adult 7-Day card
routes.description: THE event-day line for this trip. Direct, no change, every 30 minutes. Arznell (950) at 06:08 → Trincetta (6428) at 06:32 / Waqqafa (2186) at 06:33 on the first run, i.e. roughly 24–25 minutes from the Qawra seafront into Ta' Qali, continuing to the Stadium and Villagg stops used for the MFCC / National Stadium complex.
routes.notes: Stop-level departure times read directly off the operator's own route page on 9 Oct 2026. The Qawra seafront is served in the Bugibba→Rabat direction only; the return runs through St Paul's Bay and the Bugibba seafront instead. IMPORTANT LIMIT: the last return service is published at 21:26 at Bugibba Bay 1, so a match that ends later than roughly 20:45 at Ta' Qali cannot be finished by bus — see the late-night note on getting-around.html.

routes.name: Airport Direct TD1 — Airport ↔ Qawra ↔ Bugibba ↔ Cirkewwa
routes.area: Malta International Airport ↔ Rabat ↔ Qawra ↔ Bugibba ↔ Xemxija ↔ Mellieha ↔ Cirkewwa
routes.address: Stops relevant to this trip: Airport → Rabat → Qawra Arznell (950) → Bugibba Bay 2 → Xemxija → Mellieha → Cirkewwa (and the reverse)
routes.hours: Daily, hourly. Third-party atlas records 05:00, 06:00 then hourly to 23:00/00:00; approx 23 min to Rabat and 49 min to Bugibba.
routes.price_range: €3.50 (TD1 is priced above the €3.00 standard Airport Direct fare)
routes.description: The Airport Direct line that actually reaches Qawra — it calls at Arznell (950), the same Qawra seafront stop as route 186. Use it on arrival and departure days.
routes.notes: The airport's own transport page names TD1 as serving Rabat, Bugibba and Cirkewwa; the Qawra Arznell stop for TD1 is confirmed on the operator's route-186 stop list, which shows 'TD1 Airport - Cirkewwa' and 'TD1 Cirkewwa - Airport' among the routes operating from Arznell (950). The exact timetable shape (05:00 hourly) is from a third-party atlas and is NOT re-verified against the operator — treat as indicative and confirm in the tallinja app.

routes.name: Airport Direct TD5 — Airport ↔ Bugibba
routes.address: Serves Bugibba Bay 1 (2527), Arznell (950) and Wileg (955) per the operator's stop lists
routes.hours: Not re-verified at check time — confirm in the tallinja app
routes.description: A second Airport Direct option that reaches the Qawra/Bugibba seafront. Shown as a fallback to TD1.
routes.notes: Existence and Qawra-area stops confirmed via the operator's stop listings for Bugibba Bay 1, Arznell and Wileg. Frequency and terminal bay not verified this session.

routes.name: Route 214 — Bugibba ↔ Airport via Qawra, Rabat and Paola
routes.area: Bugibba ↔ Qawra ↔ Rabat ↔ Ta' Qali (Qali 2) ↔ Balzan ↔ Birkirkara ↔ Marsa ↔ Paola ↔ Airport
routes.address: Bugibba Bay 6 (3531) → Ben (949) → Arznell (950) → Luzzu (951) → Qawra (952) → Boxxla (953) → … → Airport
routes.hours: Published on the operator's route pages; a third-party atlas records the hourly 05:15–22:15 pattern inherited from the withdrawn X3. Not re-verified against the operator this session.
routes.price_range: Day Route fare (€2.00 winter / €2.50 summer) — cheaper than the €3.50 TD1 but slower
routes.description: The budget airport line for a Qawra base. Replaced the withdrawn X3 on 20 April 2025. Slower than TD1 because it runs via Rabat, Birkirkara and Paola.
routes.notes: The airport's transport page states 'Route 214 goes from the airport to Marsa, Rabat and Bugibba'. Its Qawra seafront stops are confirmed by the operator's own stop listings for Arznell/Luzzu/Qawra/Boxxla, which list '214 Bugibba - Ajruport' / '214 Ajruport - Bugibba'.

routes.name: Route 45 — Bugibba ↔ Valletta
routes.area: Bugibba / Qawra ↔ Naxxar ↔ Mosta ↔ Birkirkara ↔ Msida ↔ Valletta
routes.address: Serves Ben (949), Arznell (950), Luzzu (951), Qawra (952), Boxxla (953), Fugass (954), Wileg (955) and Bugibba Bay 6 (3531)
routes.hours: Day service; times on the operator's route page. A third-party atlas records peak-only operation (Mon–Fri morning peak 06:05 every 20 min to 08:45; evening peak 15:55 every 30 min to 17:55) — NOT re-verified against the operator.
routes.description: The direct Qawra→Valletta line for sightseeing days. Note the possible peak-only caveat below.
routes.notes: Route existence and Qawra stops verified from the operator's stop listings. The peak-only operating pattern comes from a 2025 third-party bus atlas and is NOT confirmed by the operator page this session — check in the tallinja app before relying on 45 for an off-peak Valletta run. Alternatives from the same Qawra stops: 212 (Bugibba→Sliema), 280 (Bugibba→Mater Dei), 221 (Bugibba→Cirkewwa), 223 (Bugibba→Ghajn Tuffieha).

fares.name: Single journey, Day Routes
fares.address: Buy on board: cash or contactless bank card
fares.hours: Valid 2 hours including free transfers within that period
fares.description: Cash or contactless on the bus. A €50 fine applies if you cannot show a valid ticket or have not validated.
fares.notes: The operator's page still states the winter-fare window as 19 Oct 2025 – 13 Jun 2026, which is stale relative to the trip dates; the 2026/27 window is not published. Budget €2.50 per ride and treat €2.00 as upside. See docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md OQ-02.

fares.name: Explore Adult 7-Day card
fares.address: Sales offices at Malta International Airport (Welcomer's Hall and Baggage Reclaim), Valletta Terminal, Bugibba Terminal and Sliema Ferries; card machines; Agenda / 8TillLate / WH Smith outlets; tallinja app
fares.description: Unlimited bus travel on all Day Routes and Night Routes, plus select Special Services. The best-value card for a six-night stay. There is a Bugibba Terminal sales office, close to the hotel.
fares.notes: CONTRADICTION STILL LIVE ON THE OPERATOR'S OWN PAGE: the card detail says it 'excludes tallinja Direct Routes', while the offers summary says 'This card also includes the Airport Direct service'. Buy the airport hops separately at €3.00–€3.50 each way, or ask at the Bugibba Terminal / airport kiosk. Individual use, cannot be shared.

fares.name: 12 Single Day Journeys card
fares.address: Same sales points as the Explore card
fares.description: 12 journeys on Day Routes with free transfers inside 2 hours. Shareable between travellers. Night Routes and Airport Direct each consume 2 of the 12 journeys per trip.
fares.notes: Better than the 7-day card only if you expect fewer than about 13 day-route journeys in the week.

fares.name: Explore Flex card
fares.address: Sales offices, card machines, tallinja app
fares.price_range: €21 (4-day) / €27 (7-day); + Gozo Highspeed return €36/€42; + Harbour Cruise €36/€42; 2 Islands €53/€59; 2 Islands + Harbour Cruise €68/€74; Hop-On Hop-Off €41/€51
fares.description: Unlimited bus plus a sightseeing add-on, and it can be topped up with credit in the tallinja app to pay for services including the Valletta↔Sliema/Three Cities ferry.
fares.notes: Non-shareable. 2 Airport Direct trips can be added for €6.

fares.name: Night Routes (N), Special Services (S), Airport Direct (TD)
fares.hours: Night routes run after the day network
fares.description: Night Routes €3.00, Special Services €3.00, tallinja Direct €3.00, tallinja Direct TD1 €3.50.
fares.notes: Night routes reaching the Qawra/Bugibba area include N11 (Cirkewwa↔San Giljan) and N212 (Bugibba↔Sliema); neither serves Ta' Qali, so there is no night bus back from the venue.

modes.name: Airport white-taxi fixed-fare kiosk
modes.address: 24/7 fixed-fare counter in the arrivals hall; pay at the desk, hand the receipt to the driver
modes.price_range: Published fixed fares; the Sliema band previously recorded on this site is ~€20 plus a small admin fee. A Qawra fare was NOT published at check time — get the price at the kiosk before accepting.
modes.description: The reliable door-to-door option with luggage. Roughly 20 minutes to Qawra by car.
modes.notes: CARRIED OVER from the previous session (checked 24 Sep 2026), NOT re-verified on 9 Oct 2026: the airport's transport page routes passengers to the licensed operator Malta Taxi rather than publishing its own fare table, and the old fare-table URL 404s. The ~20-minute Qawra drive time is a distance inference (the airport is ~12.8 km from the hotel per third-party distance data), not a published figure. No Qawra-specific published taxi fare exists as far as this project has found — do not state a number for Qawra until one is found. See docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md OQ-03.

modes.name: Bolt / eCabs / Uber / Ryde
modes.area: Island-wide; densest in the Sliema / St Julian's / Paceville belt and thinner in the north and inland
modes.price_range: App-determined; surge applies. No verified Qawra↔Ta' Qali quote exists — see the open question.
modes.description: The practical late-night answer for event days, because the last 186 back from Ta' Qali is published around 21:26 and no night bus serves Ta' Qali. Bolt and eCabs support advance booking, which matters for a fixed match start; Uber does not take advance bookings in Malta.
modes.notes: CARRIED OVER from the previous session (checked 23 Sep 2026), NOT re-verified on 9 Oct 2026: Uber operates in Malta (launched June 2022 per Times of Malta) with no advance booking, and Bolt, eCabs and Ryde also operate, with Bolt and eCabs taking advance bookings. No price for the Qawra↔Ta' Qali pair exists — fares are only shown in-app from a live GPS position. Recorded as unverified rather than estimated. See docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md OQ-04.

venue_access.name: BLAST Arena Studios (Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre)
venue_access.address: Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre, Ta' Qali, ATD 4000, Attard
venue_access.hours: Event doors 14–18 October 2026; per-day times not published at check time
venue_access.description: Tournament venue, inland at Ta' Qali beside the National Stadium. Reachable from Qawra by route 186 with no change, or by rideshare in roughly 20 minutes.
venue_access.notes: Address taken from BLAST's own attendee guide ('Venue: Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre - BLAST Arena Studios. Address: Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre Ta Qali, ATD 4000 H'Attard'). The guide read was for the BLAST Bounty event at the same venue; the address is the venue's, not the tournament's, so it carries over. The MFCC South Gate National Stadium / Millennium Stand formulation comes from third-party directories and is corroborating, not primary.
